question: Which region has the maximum concentration of Iron and Steel industries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chota Nagpur Plateau**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Chota Nagpur plateau **stands out as the **hub of iron and steel industries** in India, primarily due to its abundant reserves of high-grade hematite iron ore found in places like **Noamundi, Gua, Kolhan, Dharwar, and Budabaru**. 
 
• This region also boasts extensive coal deposits, further bolstering its appeal for iron and steel production.
